title: Compare a personal game collection with a reference season — compare_personal_season
text: games Data frame unique character game_id, nonmissing team season, finite numeric metric, requested stratum columns. Must contain exactly one team's one season, including selected games. game_ids Unique character IDs personally recorded games. metric Name numeric game-level measure average. Default win requires 0/1 values, mean winning percentage. strata Character vector columns match jointly. Default home preserves home/away counts. Use character(0) unrestricted sampling. simulations Positive integer number draws; default 2000.

title: Compare a personal game collection with a reference season — compare_personal_season
text: list containing summary (one row sample sizes, selected, -game season means, selected-minus-difference, 2.5th 97.5th reference percentiles, tie-adjusted percentile rank), simulated_means, settings. reference range confidence interval causal effect underlying player ability. Summary fields include personal_mean, other_mean, season_mean, difference, reference_low, reference_high, reference_percentile.

title: Compare a personal game collection with a reference season — compare_personal_season
text: Supply complete game-level records, one row per upload team side. Duplicates missing IDs errors. least one selected one unselected game required. Sampling includes selected games reference population. Use set.seed() calling reproducibility. detailed strata can leave little variation. Unmeasured selection differences remain, function test many patterns .

title: Compare a personal game collection with a reference season — compare_personal_season

title: daimondstats 0.1.0
text: Connects dAImond Inning app: daimond_auth() stores personal API key session daimond_games() downloads reviewed plays pitcher lines. Errors explain missing revoked keys, plans without API access, rate limits. New calculate_youth_stats(): OBPE (base including reaching error), ISO, strikeout walk rates, BABIP, pooled across games, small-sample flag. New check_pitch_counts() dataset pitch_smart_rules: Pitch Smart daily maximums rest days ages 7 18. -day appearances added together, short outing never cancels rest still owed. New season_report() writes self-contained one-page HTML report. New dataset demo_pitch_log, fictional 12U pitching month. New vignette, “Coaching season paper scorecards”. Tests moved testthat (3rd edition). API client tested mocked responses, tests never use network. inst/extdata/youth_analytics_parity.json holds R results app’s Python port tested . httr2 grDevices added Imports; testthat withr Suggests.

title: daimondstats 0.0.5
text: New season_games() turns MLB Stats API regular-season schedule one row per completed game. filters coded status F, postponed games also report abstract state “Final”. New dataset reviewed_team_seasons: full 162-game seasons five scorecard teams (810 rows). Win totals match team’s final record. compare_personal_season() now runs real games. vignette adds section placing scored Twins game within 2024 Twins season. jsonlite added Imports. Added pkgdown website.

title: daimondstats 0.0.4
text: New dataset reviewed_base_out: 188 offensive events base-states rebuilt MLB game feeds. Every row’s outs, bases, half-inning runs checked feed. New dataset run_expectancy_fangraphs: published FanGraphs 24-state run expectancy matrix. New plot_run_impact() draws total RE24 player. New vignette, “scorecard run value”.

title: daimondstats 0.0.3
text: New dataset reviewed_scorecards: 179 plate appearances five team scorecards. Every player’s team’s counting totals match official MLB box scores. Revised documentation functions datasets.

title: daimondstats 0.0.2
text: New compare_personal_season() compares set scored games -size samples one team’s season, matched home away. New calculate_run_impact() computes event-level RE24 base-transitions 24-state run expectancy matrix. New dataset twins_scorecard_2024: 35 plays one Twins game.
